text: As I said before, my father and her mother were brother and sister, just as you might be”--Tommy did not correct this view of their relationship--“but they didn’t always get on together. And when my aunt made up her mind to marry Amos Finn, who was a poor school teacher out West, my father was just mad! Said if he made his pile, as he seemed in a fair way to do, she’d never see a cent of it. Well, the upshot was that Aunt Jane went out West and we never heard from her again. “The old man did pile it up.
